{
  "test_name": "Case 2: Edge Case Numbers",
  "description": "Validate edge cases: zero, negative numbers, large numbers, very small floats, false boolean",
  "input": {
    "zero": 0,
    "negative_int": -999,
    "large_int": 2147483647,
    "negative_float": -123.456,
    "very_small_float": 1e-07,
    "bool_false": false
  },
  "expected_output": {
    "zero": 0,
    "negative_int": -999,
    "large_int": 2147483647,
    "negative_float": -123.456,
    "very_small_float": 1e-07,
    "bool_false": false
  },
  "validation_strategy": "field_by_field_comparison",
  "type_check": "type(returned_value) == type(original_value)",
  "value_check": "returned_value == original_value"
}
